title: Historia expulsionis Adae e paradiso (Armenian Expulsion from Paradise)

details.intro:
The Historia expulsionis Adae e paradiso is an Armenian haggadic writing focusing intensely on the emotional and cosmic grief of Adam and Eve upon being driven out of the Garden of Eden, their realization of physical nakedness and mortality, and Adam's desperate supplication at the gates of Paradise.

Like CAVT 16, it is transmitted in two recensions within medieval Armenian liturgical and historical codices, edited by Yovsēp‘ianc‘ and Lipscomb.
details.provenance:
Language: Classical Armenian.
Date: Medieval Armenian transmission drawing on late antique Vorlagen.
details.manuscripts: • Manuscripts: Erevan, Matenadaran MSS 1500, 3519, 4618; Jerusalem, Armenian Patriarchate MS 1735.
